title: ActorModelManageResult
description: actor.model-manage-result@1: what GET /api/v1/me/model answers, and what PUT /api/v1/me/model answers: { choice, provider, model, updated_at, keys }. choice is what you chose; provider is the provider your own key is for (or nothing); model is the model id you picked (or nothing); updated_at is when you last changed it; keys are the providers you hold a key for in OpenVibe.AI (names only, never key material), or null when OpenVibe.AI does not tell a service.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601, or nothing when you never changed it.

keys.description: The providers you hold a key for, names only. Null when OpenVibe.AI does not tell a service.
